svg.title: Illustration: AI co-pilot suggests several reply drafts in the ticket; the team picks one, edits it and sends it.

g.text: from your knowledge base and past conversations
Hi Sophie, of course! You can move your appointment yourself under “My appointments”.
Hi Sophie, that's no problem. Just tell us which date suits you best.
Hi Sophie, thanks for your message! I'll check for free slots right away.
Your team reviews, edits and sends.
